[{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Bachelor of Science Major in Psychology with Departmental Honors","groupId":"3f6492c0-606f-4226-88de-0195625b53a0","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

To be awarded a degree in Psychology with Honors at graduation, you must accomplish three learning outcomes: 

1) A minimum overall GPA of 3.4.

2) A minimum GPA of 3.8 for courses within the major.

3) An applied or research project approved and supervised by a faculty member in the Psychology department.

","groupId":"c0c9ff64-8fe3-4821-9c92-0195625b53a0","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"General Education Requirements","groupId":"3bd6fd91-cfcf-4133-93cd-0195625cad9e","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

For more details, see General Education

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include the following requirements.

","groupId":"60b3798f-0b3e-4e44-9353-0195625cad9e","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Core Requirements","groupId":"31de54a6-9f14-4bfc-9575-0195625cad9f","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit. 

2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars.  

","groupId":"1c1794aa-56bf-4ff4-a0cd-0195625cad9f","position":5,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Breadth Requirement (7 courses, at least 3 units each)","groupId":"d9af06ae-3910-4d9b-af32-0195625ea020","position":6,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement.

2) Students must complete 60 units outside the primary discipline of the first major, regardless of the department who offers the course(s) in that discipline, (Courses include general education courses, transfer courses, CPCE/EXTN units, internships, etc.)


","groupId":"73fd4ab8-32d9-454f-929f-0195625ea020","position":7,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Diversity and Inclusion Requirement","groupId":"572322d3-db46-4dd6-896f-0195625f471d","position":8,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Note: Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements.

","groupId":"02425d92-ff81-42f8-89ed-0195625f471d","position":9,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Fundamental Skills","groupId":"43fd41da-04dd-412a-af00-0195625fde62","position":10,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must demonstrate competence in:

Writing

Quantitative Analysis (Math)

Note:  Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.

Notes:

1) Students must take 53 units with 4 additional units at Pacific from the two options given in section 3G with another Advanced Psychology core course and Lab.

2)  If an Advanced Lab is taken, it may be the same numbered course as a previously taken Lab IF the title of the course is different.
